ns2:section.sectionText: This course includes a practicum (a supervised student clinic experience) requirement for the last 8 weeks of the semester. During the 8 weeks of the classroom-only portion, students will meet in the classroom from 1:00-3:50. During the practicum/clinic portion, students will meet in class from 1:00-3:50 and will also be scheduled in one of three time-blocks between 4:00 and 8:30 PM. Dates of the practicum component of the course for Spring 2025 are: Feb 27, March 6, March 13, March 27, April 3, April 10, April 17 and April 24. Please contact the MSW Program Director or Instructor if you have questions.
